plans.ligne: I'm literally an AI setter, and I'm begging you: do not fire your human setter.
plans.jeu: Walking selfie, frustrated and urgent, high energy: free hand pressed toward the lens pleading on 'begging you', shaking slightly, then a sharp index finger jab at the camera on 'do not fire', eyebrows high, jaw tense, intense eyes, constant micro-movements.

flow.note: 1er essai refusé par Flow (« prominent people », faux positif, remboursé) ; 2e essai sans le prénom dans le prompt : OK

plans.ligne_gardee: do not fire your human setter.

plans.ligne: Every ad says replace your setter with AI. Let the AI take the 11 p.m. "how much", your human takes the calls. That's exactly why we built ManySetter.
plans.jeu: Walking selfie, then he stops abruptly and brings the phone closer; rolls his eyes on 'every ad', counts on his fingers on '11 p.m.', firm hand chop on 'takes the calls', then a confident half smile. Talks fast, no pauses, casual and natural.

voix: His voice: warm American male voice, mid-low pitch, relaxed but quick and confident delivery, dry playful humor, clear diction, natural pauses, no vocal fry, General American accent.
cadrage: selfie en marchant dans le couloir de l'appartement, caméra frontale à bout de bras, décor à peine lisible
